blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Saying former president Rodrigo Duterte is out of the coercive power of the Supreme Court, it has dismissed the consolidated petitions for a writ of habeas corpus challenging the former leader’s March 2025 arrest and turn over to the International Criminal Court. “Significantly, [Duterte] is not just beyond the Court’s coercive powers, but also stands accused before an international tribunal that has assumed jurisdiction over his person,” the Supreme Court stated in its ruling. In a decision penned by Associate Justice Japar B. Dimaampao and released by the SC Office of the Spokesperson on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, […]...
